title: High School DxD BorN: Ishibumi Ichiei Kanzen Kanshuu! Mousou Bakuyure Kaijo Original Video
justification: AniList 21279 (SPECIAL, 6 episode(s) from 2015-07-24) is AniDB 10691's special(s) S1-S6, aired 2015-07-24 to 2016-01-27. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 20745, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 10691, the specials' titles 'Maximum Titillation: ...' match the AniList English title, and AniDB lists MAL 31326 on AniDB 10691. The parent's rows place them on TVDB 254653 0x11-0x14, 0x16 and 0x17, whose titles and dates agree.
